subject.title: Feature: Activity-based heartbeat with idle timeout

question: Should heartbeat gain an opt-in activity-based idle window, and if so which inbound activity boundary should reactivate it?
rationale: The request adds public configuration and changes when proactive agent work runs; source inspection establishes the missing capability but cannot choose the permanent user-facing semantics or compatibility default.

options.title: Add Opt-In Idle Window
options.body: Add an optional duration that suppresses scheduled heartbeats after recent allowed inbound activity expires while preserving current behavior when unset.

options.title: Use Narrow Token-Saving Rules
options.body: Address idle cost only through missing-HEARTBEAT.md, no-due-work, and event-wake checks without introducing general activity-based scheduling.

options.title: Decline New Configuration
options.body: Keep interval and active-hours as the supported controls and document manual disabling or isolated cron workflows for users who do not want continuous heartbeats.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Idle Window
recommendation.body: Add an optional duration that suppresses scheduled heartbeats after recent allowed inbound activity expires while preserving current behavior when unset.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent heartbeat implementation history and prior issue review make this the strongest available routing candidate for the scheduling and configuration decision.
